description: Bounded local Git-only W0 workload. It deliberately does not start the Rootyard binary, PostgreSQL, Redis, Raft or a Blob provider.
notes: repo_count * pushes_per_repo must not exceed bounds.max_git_push_ops
cas_rounds * cas_concurrency must not exceed bounds.max_cas_ops
PG, API and Blob sections are disabled for W0 and their metrics must be reported unavailable with null values
